title: Born in Mhow
oneLine: Born on 14 April 1891 in the town of Mhow (now Dr. Ambedkar Nagar), Central Provinces, British India.

verification.sourceNote: Verify against official records; widely cited date.

title: Studies at Columbia University, New York
oneLine: Begins studies at Columbia University, New York, on a scholarship from the Baroda State.

verification.sourceNote: Verify year of enrolment against Columbia University records or Ambedkar's writings.

title: Studies at the London School of Economics
oneLine: Begins studies at the London School of Economics, pursuing advanced research in economics and law.

title: Launches the periodical Mooknayak
oneLine: Launches the Marathi-language periodical Mooknayak (Voice of the Mute) on 31 January 1920.

verification.sourceNote: Verify launch date against copies of Mooknayak or bibliographic records.

title: Mahad Satyagraha
oneLine: Leads the Mahad Satyagraha in March 1927 to assert the right to use public water resources.

title: Kalaram Temple Entry Satyagraha, Nashik
oneLine: Leads the Kalaram Temple Entry Satyagraha at Nashik on 2 March 1930 to assert rights of entry.

verification.sourceNote: Verify date and details against historical accounts or Maharashtra records.

title: Poona Pact
oneLine: The Poona Pact is signed on 24 September 1932, an agreement regarding reserved legislative seats.

verification.sourceNote: Verify against the text of the Poona Pact; widely documented in Constituent Assembly and government records.

title: Independent India's first Law Minister
oneLine: Appointed as independent India's first Law Minister on 15 August 1947.

verification.sourceNote: Verify against Government of India gazette or official cabinet formation records.

title: Chairman of the Constitution Drafting Committee
oneLine: Elected Chairman of the Constituent Assembly's Drafting Committee on 29 August 1947.

verification.sourceNote: Verify against Constituent Assembly of India proceedings, Volume V.

title: Constitution adopted by the Constituent Assembly
oneLine: The Constitution of India is adopted by the Constituent Assembly on 26 November 1949.

verification.sourceNote: Verify against Constituent Assembly of India proceedings and the Preamble to the Constitution.

title: Constitution comes into effect
oneLine: The Constitution of India comes into effect on 26 January 1950, marking Republic Day.

verification.sourceNote: Verify against Government of India Gazette Extraordinary, 26 January 1950.

title: Embraces Buddhism at Nagpur
oneLine: Embraces Buddhism at Nagpur on 14 October 1956 in a public ceremony.

verification.sourceNote: Verify against contemporary newspaper records and official accounts of the Nagpur ceremony.

title: Passes away in Delhi
oneLine: Passes away in Delhi on 6 December 1956. The date is observed as Mahaparinirvan Diwas.
